description.summary: The caster can emulate a charging up effect similar to the Zaghnol
description.value: The caster can emulate a charging up effect similar to the Zaghnol. Once the caster has determined what the effect is, the caster can choose who and where to target it. If the caster doesn’t like their result, they can cancel the effect but at the cost of casting time and MP used. To determine the effect of the charge, roll a 1d10 on the following chart: 1d10 Spell Effect 1 Thunder 2, 3, 4 Thunder II 5, 6 Defensive Shock 7, 8 Elemental Touch (Lightning) 9 Thundara 10 Thunder III Learned From Zaghnol and Ochre Jelly
